title: Implement circuit-breaker for /v4/charge endpoint
description: Wrap the new v4 charge call with Resilience4j circuit-breaker. States: closed (normal), open (fail-fast 503), half-open (probe). Alert on open.

title: Write Pact contract test for processor v4 API
description: Create consumer-side Pact contract covering /v4/charge, /v4/refund, /v4/status. Publish to PactBroker and wire into CI.

title: Migrate Payments API integration library from v3 to v4
description: Update request/response models, error codes, and retry policies to match v4 contract.

title: Add Payments API canary deployment configuration
description: Configure Argo Rollouts canary: 5% → 25% → 100% with error-rate rollback gate.

title: Replace timestamp idempotency keys with UUID v7
description: Update BillingEngine.charge() to generate UUID v7 idempotency keys on each attempt.

title: Add duplicate-charge detection alert
description: Query the charges table for duplicate amounts within 5 minutes for the same customer; alert if found.

title: Build billing reconciliation daily report
description: Generate a daily reconciliation CSV comparing our records against the processor's settlement report.

title: Deploy cert-expiry Prometheus exporter
description: Add blackbox-exporter cert-expiry probe to all Tier-1 services. Alert at 30 days and 7 days.

title: Harden cert rotation script with expiry validation
description: Add pre-rotation expiry check to rotate-certs.sh. Fail loudly if new cert is expired before adding to pool.

title: Route all analytics queries to read replica
description: Update analytics role connection string to point to read replica host. Validate with smoke tests.

title: Enforce 300s statement_timeout for analytics role
description: Add statement_timeout=300000 to analytics PostgreSQL role. Document in runbook.

title: Integrate Vonage as secondary SMS provider
description: Add VonageSMSAdapter implementing the SMSGateway interface. Add to priority router.

title: Implement SMS priority router with fallback logic
description: Route SMS through Twilio first; fall back to Vonage on 429 or 5xx. Alert when secondary is active > 5 min.

title: Build Argo Rollouts canary pipeline template
description: Parameterised Argo Rollouts template: steps 5%/15m → 25%/30m → 100%. Auto-rollback on error_rate > 1%.

title: Document network policy change-review process
description: Write runbook for network policy change review: PR template, review checklist, staging soak, promotion criteria.
